== Notes ==
* Similar to [[Psychic Distraction]], Signet of Distraction will bypass anti-interrupt skills. While you may not be able to interrupt the spell during casting, the foe's spell will become disabled and not be able to complete casting.
{{bug|Contrary to the concise description, the interrupt does not need to succeed for the spell to become disabled.}}
